thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — Q2 spot awards round is open. We want to do a small push before the product launch to highlight ops heroes and tie a few awards to the launch happy hour. Nominate people by end of day Friday.

alex: Awesome, thanks! What's the per-award amount and cap?

maria: $250 per spot award, up to 8 awards (so $2k total). Managers must approve nominees. We'll do two groups: product-launch-specific and general kudos.

jamie: I'll take notes and create the shortlist. How do folks submit nominations?

maria: Use the nomination form: https://redwood.internal/hr/spot-award-form or the quick Slack command: `/spot-award nominate @person "reason" 250`

sam: Can we nominate contractors? We had a contractor who saved the deploy last week.

maria: Yes, contractors and vendors are eligible, finance just needs a cost center. Put the contractor company name in the form.

hrbot: :bell: Reminder: Nomination deadline is Fri 5pm PT. Managers must approve by Mon noon for payroll coding.

alex: For approvals, do we notify managers manually or does the form route approval?

maria: The form routes to the nominee's manager automatically. If the manager is out, cc your director. Quick checklist to include in the form: nominee name, role, reason (2-3 lines), example impact, cost center, manager email.

jamie: I'll compile the approved list and propose a slate of 6 (4 launch, 2 general). Want us to add a short blurb for the happy hour shout-outs?

maria: Yes please — 1-2 sentence blurb for each winner so we can read it aloud at the happy hour. Also we'll drop a slide in the all-hands.

lina: Finance OKs the $2k budget for Q2 spot awards. Please tag me (@lina) when the final list is ready so I can code it to the right GL.

sam: Can we do a non-cash micro-recognition too? Maybe a custom enamel pin for winners? Cost estimate?

maria: Love that — low-cost pins are fine but keep it separate from the cash award. If pins cost >$100 total, get pre-approval from finance.

alex: One more ops detail — can we get a small sign for the happy hour table that says "Redwood Heroes"? Happy to order.

maria: Yes! Thanks. Sam/alex — coordinate with facilities and put the sign cost under events.

hrbot: :white_check_mark: Nomination checklist: name, role, reason, impact example, cost center, manager approval. Deadline: Fri 5pm PT.

jamie: I'll share the doc w/ nominees on Mon and tag managers for approvals.

maria: Perfect. Thanks all — will post the form in #general and drop reminders. Any objections to the process?

alex: No objections. :thumbsup:

lina: All good from finance.

maria: Great — closing loop. Will post follow-ups and the event slide template later today. :party:
